feed.title: enterpriseai.tools weekly updates — governance
feed.subtitle: High-impact market intelligence for enterprise AI tooling, with an expandable release log for lower-signal product changes.

entry.title: Org policies can mandate Model Armor filters
entry.summary: Custom organization policies, now generally available, can require that all new or updated Model Armor templates enforce mandatory filters, such as responsible AI and prompt-injection and jailbreak detection.

entry.title: NemoClaw v0.0.137 defaults to Nemotron 3.5 Super VL
entry.summary: NemoClaw v0.0.137 makes Nemotron 3.5 Super VL the default hosted model for new OpenClaw and Hermes onboarding and improves uninstall recovery, managed image security and policy recovery.

entry.title: Guardrails grounding checks add a Standard tier
entry.summary: Bedrock Guardrails contextual grounding checks now support the Standard tier, which handles reasoning and conversational responses with more consistent scores and more languages. It needs cross-Region inference; Classic stays the default.

source.title: Use contextual grounding check to filter hallucinations in responses

entry.title: Google Model Armor — feature
entry.summary: Model Armor improved prompt-injection and jailbreak protection for Workspace data such as emails, docs and files, on US and EU multi-region endpoints with filter version v3 or later.

entry.title: NeMo Guardrails — release
entry.summary: NeMo Guardrails 0.24.1 fixed benchmark concurrency measurement, Nemotron 3.5 response parsing, server overload handling, and combined-config loading.

entry.title: Guardrails AI — deprecation
entry.summary: Guardrails AI 0.11.0 deprecated its Hub CLI and private validator registry as the project moved validator distribution to public PyPI.

entry.title: LLM Guard — deprecation
entry.summary: Protect AI archived the LLM Guard repository; the project and its Hugging Face models are no longer under active development.

entry.title: NeMo Guardrails — release
entry.summary: NeMo Guardrails 0.23.0 expanded IORails with streaming and non-streaming tool-call validation, added a standalone /v1/checks validation endpoint, and improved OpenTelemetry observability for production guardrail pipelines.

entry.title: NeMo Guardrails adds parallel IORails safety execution
entry.summary: NeMo Guardrails' March 12 release introduced IORails for parallel input/output safety execution, plus OpenAI-compatible server support and standalone async rail validation.

entry.title: Check Point moves to acquire Lakera
entry.summary: Check Point announced an agreement to acquire Lakera, positioning the startup's AI-native protection stack inside a broader end-to-end enterprise AI security portfolio.

source.title: Check Point Acquires Lakera to Deliver End-to-End AI Security for Enterprises
